name: EFORCE
recent: Excel Force 于2026年9月宣布最多10%的私募配股，并在9月底获Bursa Securities批准上市最多60,987,800股配售股。同期出现大股东变动：TS Wong（Wong Thean Soon）及Asia Internet Holdings退出大股东行列，Jeff Wang（Wang Kuen-Chung）重新成为主要股东。公司也更换了公司秘书、股票登记处及注册地址，并更改财政年度结束日。
notable: Bursa Securities于2026年9月30日批准最多60,987,800股配售股的上市及报价。
TS Wong及Asia Internet Holdings不再是公司大股东，Jeff Wang重新成为主要股东。
risks: 私募配股最多10%的已发行股份，可能摊薄现有股东持股。
大股东TS Wong及Asia Internet Holdings在2026年9月至10月期间退出大股东行列。
媒体报导质疑公司RM26.6 mil资金的去向。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为RM8.312 mil，环比增长16.5%，同比增长20.2%；净利为RM1.948 mil，环比增长77.4%，净利率为23.4%，高于上一季度的15.4%。

recent_en: In September 2026, Excel Force announced a private placement of up to 10% of its shares and obtained Bursa Securities' approval in late September to list up to 60,987,800 placement shares. Major shareholder changes occurred during the same period: TS Wong (Wong Thean Soon) and Asia Internet Holdings ceased to be substantial shareholders, while Jeff Wang (Wang Kuen-Chung) re-emerged as a major shareholder. The company also changed its company secretaries, share registrar and registered address, and changed its financial year end.
notable_en: Proposed private placement of up to 10% of issued shares at an issue price to be determined.
Bursa Securities approved the listing and quotation of up to 60,987,800 placement shares on 30 September 2026.
TS Wong and Asia Internet Holdings ceased to be substantial shareholders, while Jeff Wang re-emerged as a major shareholder.
risks_en: The private placement of up to 10% of issued shares may dilute existing shareholders' holdings.
Substantial shareholders TS Wong and Asia Internet Holdings exited during September to October 2026.
Media reports questioned where the company's RM26.6 mil went.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM8.312 mil, up 16.5% QoQ and 20.2% YoY; net income was RM1.948 mil, up 77.4% QoQ, with a net margin of 23.4% versus 15.4% in the previous quarter.
